set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interfaces [interface].explanation: The command `set interfaces [interface]` in Junos configures a specific network interface by defining its properties and enabling it for network operations.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be configured

unit [unit] family [family].explanation: Configure interface settings including interface name, unit number, and family type for Ethernet switching

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: The unit number for the interface configuration

parameters.name: family
parameters.explanation: The family type for the interface, such as ethernet-switching

unit [unit] family [family] address [add.explanation: Configure an interface with a specific unit, family, and IP address

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: The unit number for the interface configuration

parameters.name: family
parameters.explanation: The protocol family (e.g., inet for IPv4)

parameters.name: address
parameters.explanation: The IP address and subnet mask in CIDR notation
